rangeInfo.note: Niche's grind size guide, Niche Zero column: espresso 5–20, moka pot 20–30, AeroPress 30–35, V60 35–45, French press 45+.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: French press: 45–55, from Niche's open-ended “45+”; Turkish: from zero to the start of the espresso range; moka pot: from the top of the espresso range to halfway to the top of the AeroPress range (or one AeroPress span finer when there's no espresso range); drip coffee maker: the pour-over range; cold brew: the French press range moved half its width coarser; Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
